item.description:
## What's new
- **Astronomical now ships with a skill for AI agents.** Coding tools and chat harnesses connected to Astronomical are told where it is, so their agents can learn on their own how to draw images, read text aloud, describe pictures, run decision models, connect tools and troubleshoot Astronomical. Nothing needs installing. - **The skill keeps itself current.** About once a day Astronomical checks the website for a newer skill, verifies every file against its published SHA-256 digest, and swaps it in whole. Nothing about your Mac or its use is sent. - **Two new settings** in Observatory, under "Astronomical skill": one tells models about the skill, and one keeps it up to date from the website. Both are on by default and apply at once without unloading the model. - **`astronomical speak` now speaks aloud** on your Mac's speakers. Pass `--output FILE.wav` to save the audio instead.
## Fixes
- The menu bar no longer shows "Not running" while a speech or decision model is loaded.
## Compatibility
- `astronomical speak` without `--output` no longer saves a file. Scripts that relied on the saved file should pass `--output`. - Your settings, conversations and downloaded models are kept. The new `skill` settings section is optional. - Requires macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon.
The app and disk image are signed with Developer ID, notarized and stapled by Apple, and the update feed is signed.
